units.source_text: 源氏公子身穿便服，走到南面栏杆旁边，暂且眺望庭中景色。

en.t: Prince Genji, dressed in informal clothes, walked over to the railing on the south side and for a while gazed out at the garden.

units.source_text: 西边房间里的妇女们连忙把格子窗打开，窥看源氏公子。

en.t: The women in the western room hurriedly opened the lattice window and peered out at Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 廊下设有屏风，她们只能从屏风上端约略窥见公子的容姿。

en.t: Because screens had been set up along the corridor, they could only glimpse the prince's figure faintly over the top of them.

units.source_text: 其中有几个轻狂女子，看了这个美男子，简直铭感五中呢。

en.t: Among them were a few frivolous women who, at the sight of this beautiful young man, were deeply stirred to the very heart.

units.source_text: 下弦的残月发出淡淡的光，轮廓还是很清楚，倒觉得这晨景别有风趣。

en.t: The waning half moon gave off a pale light, its outline still clear, and the morning scene seemed to have a special charm of its own.

units.source_text: 天色本无成见，只因观者心情不同，有的觉得优艳，有的觉得凄凉。

en.t: The sky itself has no fixed bias; only because viewers bring different feelings to it does it seem elegant to some and desolate to others.

units.source_text: 心中秘藏恋情的源氏公子，看了这景色只觉得痛心。

en.t: Prince Genji, hiding love deep within his heart, looked at this scene and felt only pain.

units.source_text: 他想：“今后连通信的机会也没有了！”

en.t: He thought, "From now on, even the chance to exchange letters will be gone!"

units.source_text: 终于难分难舍地离开了这地方。

en.t: At last, finding it painfully hard to part, he left the place behind.
